versions.content: Timing-requirements of SW-Components Type: valid Description: The SW-Component template must allow specifying the timing-requirements of each runnable entity of a SW-Component (e.g.): • Period • Reaction time Rationale: The SW-Component template must allow describing: • how often it has to be run • the time between a stimulus like e.g. the state change of a hardware or software entity and the expected reaction of the system (e.g. response, actuator activation) Use Case: None Dependencies: [RS_TIMEX_00013] Supporting Material: None
